pages.text: The beaked mask keeps out bad air but only halves the danger of a bite or of handling the sick. A waxed $(l)coat$(), $(l)trousers$() and $(l)boots$() each take a share of the rest.$(br2)In the $(2)full garb$(), no bite, blow, flea or corpse can infect you. Coughs and miasma still need the mask, or a censer.
